result.topic_en: Elasticity calculations: stress components ($N_i$, $T_i$) for displacement fields derived from derivatives of $1/r$ (singular point solutions), and the torque/moment integrals $\int rr\,d\Pi(yX-xY)$ over a sphere.
result.transcription:
$y(xN_1+yT_3+zT_2)\ r\,d\Pi$
$-x(xT_3+yN_2+zT_1)\ r\,d\Pi$

$\mu\, r\,d\Pi\Big(2xy\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\right)+(yy-xx)\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)+yz\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\right)-xz\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}\right)\Big)$

[-$\varphi=\frac{xy}{r^3}$-] $\varphi=\frac{xx-yy}{r^3}$ $u=(\mu+\lambda)\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x}+u'$ $\theta=-\mu\Delta^2\varphi$ [-...-] $\theta=(\mu+\lambda)\Delta^2\varphi+\theta'$
$\theta'=-(\lambda+2\mu)\Delta^2\varphi$
$N_1=-\mu\lambda\Delta^2\varphi+2\mu(\mu+\lambda)\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial x^2}+2\mu\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x}$ $T_1=\mu(\mu+\lambda)2\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial y\partial z}+\mu\left(\frac{\partial v'}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial w'}{\partial y}\right)$
$\Delta^2\varphi=-2\left(\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x^2}-\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial y^2}\right)$ $\theta'=2(\lambda+2\mu)\left(\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x^2}-\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial y^2}\right)$, $u'=2(\lambda+2\mu)\frac{\partial\frac1r}{\partial x}$, $v'=-2(\lambda+2\mu)\frac{\partial\frac1r}{\partial y}$
$w'=0$
$\varphi=\frac{xy}{r^3}$ $\Delta^2\varphi=-2\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial y\partial x}$ $\theta'=2(\lambda+2\mu)\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x\partial y}$ $u'=(\lambda+2\mu)\frac{\partial\frac1r}{\partial y}$ $v'=(\lambda+2\mu)\frac{\partial\frac1r}{\partial x}$

$u=\frac{\partial\frac1r}{\partial y}$ $v=-\frac{\partial\frac1r}{\partial x}$ $w=0$ $\theta=0$

$4xy\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x\partial y}+(xx-yy)\left(\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x^2}-\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial y^2}\right)+yz\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial y\partial z}+xz\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x\partial z}$

$-\frac{x}{r^3}$ $-\frac1{r^3}+3\frac{xx}{r^5}$

$\frac3{r^5}\left(4x^2y^2+(xx-yy)^2+y^2z^2+x^2z^2\right)$ $\frac3{r^3}(xx+yy)$ $\frac3{rr}$

$3\mu\,d\Pi\frac{xx+yy}{rr}=\mu\,6\pi\int d\Pi\left(1-\frac{zz}{rr}\right)$ $\frac{r}{\mu}X=2x\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x\partial y}+y\left(\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial y^2}-\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x^2}\right)+z\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial y\partial z}$
$N_1=2\mu\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x\partial y}$ $T_1=-\mu\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x\partial z}$ $\frac{r}{\mu}Y=x\left(\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial y^2}-\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x^2}\right)-2y\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x\partial y}-z\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x\partial z}$
$N_2=-2\mu\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x\partial y}$ $T_2=\mu\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial y\partial z}$ $\frac{r}{\mu}Z=x\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial y\partial z}-y\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x\partial z}$
$N_3=0$ $T_3=\mu\left(\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial y^2}-\frac{\partial^2\frac1r}{\partial x^2}\right)$ $\int rr\,d\Pi(yX-xY)=\mu\,8\pi$
[-...-]$\frac{yXr}{\mu}=\frac3{r^5}\left(2x^2y^2+yy(yy-xx)+yyzz\right)=\frac3{r^3}yy$ $\int rr\,d\Pi\,yX=\mu\,4\pi$
